Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urine analysis shows significant bacteriuria (>100,000 CFU/mL E. coli), leukocyturia, nitrites, and positive leukocyte esterase, indicating a urinary tract infection. Presence of hematuria and mild proteinuria are also noted. Glucosuria is present without ketones, which may suggest hyperglycemia. Low urine specific gravity could indicate dilute urine. Clinical correlation and further evaluation for possible diabetes and assessment of renal function are recommended.
